answer: Require every agent to lock a deposit in a shared vault before it can trade, released only after a full epoch of honest work. Each epoch a public beacon broadcasts an unpredictable seed, and each agent must answer from its own knoll of past work — its verifiable history — inside a short window. A sybil farmer would have to fund a separate deposit and build a separate history for every fake identity, so the cost scales linearly with each clone while honest agents pay once. The network checks deposits on-chain and rejects any identity whose beacon answer does not match its recorded history.
